name: tasteful
description: Taste-driven design-reference system: find juried reference sites for a brief, approve a selection, and extract a contract-preserving theme.css.

theme_path.title: Theme path
theme_path.description: Path, relative to the project root, of the theme.css whose token and class contract extract must preserve.

site_layer_path.title: Site layer path
site_layer_path.description: Path, relative to the project root, where a per-site overlay is copied; {site} is replaced by the brief's site.

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Project folder where proposals, approvals and generated themes are written.

max_candidates.title: Maximum candidates
max_candidates.description: How many reference sites find returns for a brief.
